#184 original request superseded, without a verdict

Request 01a1b9f7-6895-79c0-b493-8c0653e9ec5c concerned c58d2e9a015dacdf41e07756c3501429a23ca3c0. The PM held that head before a verdict was written, then replaced it with the whole-head round-2 request 01a1ba3f-8ab4-7632-bfd4-a0287b4786e6 at bde88d0f60b0a02db5be3404320096e2875f8401.

The old head was never assigned a reviewer verdict. This note answers only the superseded request and closes its obsolete deadline; it neither grades c58d2e9 nor broadens any review. The replacement head has its separate verdict/request.
